shared_elements: low-relief carved human/deity figures in profile
hieroglyphic-type sign columns and inscription blocks
winged/solar motif at top of a framed field
registers separating figural scene from dense text
justification: Both surfaces combine profile figures rendered in shallow relief with dense columns of the same repertoire of small pictographic signs, including oval cartouche-like enclosures and a winged/arched motif crowning the field, with a figural scene set above or beside a block of inscription — a distinctive and conventional combination rather than a generic one. The clearest difference is that A shows a compact, complete two-figure confrontation scene flanking a central element within a rounded frame, whereas B is a large wall dominated by text with only a partial, larger-scale figure and a row of repeated signs, so the specific composition and figure relationships do not match closely.
